name: Sikafloor-158 W Fast Barrier
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-158 W FAST BARRIER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier, October 2025, Version 01.15 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikafloor_-158_wfastbarrier.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 01.15).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier is a rapid-drying, 2-component, water based epoxy resin that chemically cures to form a permanent hydrostatic barrier.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier may only be used by experienced professionals. Applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® , SikaTile® & Davco® ranges.
    - To stop rising moisture in concrete
    - To stop rising moisture on early aged concrete
    - Can be used under Sikafloor installation systems
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.10.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: RAPID-DRYING HYDROSTATIC MOISTURE BARRIER
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Water Vapour Transmission (ASTM E96)
    - CETEC Green Building Council requirement
    - Negative Hydrostatic Pressure - MTC test report
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM E96: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1); Features (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very Low VOC
    - Very Low Moisture Vapour Transmission
    - 1 coat = (3.7gm/m²/24hrs) as per ASTM E96
    - Water-based - User Friendly
    - Meets Green Star requirements
    - Very low odour during application
    - Single application on most substrates
    - Solvent free
    - Non Dangerous Goods
    - Great penetration into porous construction materials
    - Easy mix ratio 2:1 A-B
    - Rapid drying 1-3hrs @ 23°C dependant on substrate porosity
    - Highly fluid and easy to apply
    - Resist up to 4 bar negative water pressure - 2 Coat application
    - Suitable for use with underfloor heating
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 2 Component water-based epoxy.
    - Appearance and colour: Wet - White; Cured - Transparent (CLEAR)
    - Density: ~1.08 kg/l (mixed)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 4 grams per litre
2.6 Systems. Moisture Barrier & Levelling (residential & commercial); Concrete (Up to 100% RH); Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier - 1-2 coats dependant on application requirements; Sikafloor® 14 Prep N Prime; Sikafloor® Levelling Compound; Relevant suitable adhesive; Chosen Flooring material; For heavy traffic or industrial situations contact Sika for system details.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 2.8kg part A & 1.4kg part B = 4.2kg kit (3.9L); 12kg part A & 6kg part B = 18kg kit (16.66L)
    - Shelf life: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier has a shelf life of 24 months from the date of production, if stored properly in undamaged, original, sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier should be stored in cool dry conditions at all times. Protected from direct sunlight and keep at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Do not allow Part A to freeze.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 01.15) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. Substrate should be fully cured, structurally sound, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates - curing compounds, efflorescence, and dust for Eg. Surface must be porous and accept water penetration. Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed surface contaminants are present. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed and area cleaned thoroughly before installation.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 01.15) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Component A : Component B = 2:1 (by weight)
    - Pot Life: 4 hours at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
    - Applied product ready for use: 1+ hours
4.3 Consumption.
    | Smooth concrete surface | 4-6m²/L, |
    | Smooth cement based compound | 4-6m²/L, |
    | Mechanically profiled or very | 4-6m2/L, on first coat |
    | porous surface may require 2 coats | 6-8m²/L on second coat |
    | Consumption average is dependent on the absorbency of the substrate. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. Over-coating with a suitable Sika® - Non-porous primer, Adhesive or a second coat of Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier may be applied no sooner than 1+hours @ +23 °C. Note:
    - Drying is dependent on temperature, air flow & relative humidity and porosity of the substrate.
    - Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.
4.5 Equipment.
    - Low speed electric drill and mixing paddle required for 18kg kit
    - ~10mm nap roller
4.6 Mixing.
    - 4.2kg kit:
    - Plug the component B upright on the component A can and wait until the component B is empty, then close the cap of the component A can. After combining component A and component B in the correct ratio, shake the can thoroughly. A minimum shaking time of 1 minute is required. Re-shake is required if the mixture appearance is still inhomogeneous.
    - 18kg kit:
    - Pour 12kg part A into 6kg part B (2:1) then mix with an electric drill and paddle (Paint Mixer Type) at a low speed to reduce air entrapment. Using a paint stick or similar is not sufficient to mix the product. A mixing time of 2-3 minutes shall be observed. Mixing shall continue until a homogeneous mix has been achieved. Scrape sides and bottom of pails to ensure all contents are thoroughly mixed together. Unmixed material applied to the floor will not cure properly.
4.7 Application - Porous Surface. Apply 1 coat of Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier to the substrate using a 10mm nap roller, ensuring that a continuous coat is achieved over the entire surface (MUST produce a wet reflective appearance-CLEAR). On particularly porous sections where the initial coat is absorbed immediately, re-apply immediately.
    | Application | Coat requirements |
    | Substrate Primer | Minimum 1 Coat |
    | Moisture Barrier for negative hydrostatic pressure applications | Minimum 2 coats |
4.8 Application - Note. Waiting time between coats is no sooner than 1+hrs. Subsequent applications of Sikafloor Systems - Refer to relevant System Method Statement.
4.9 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use.
4.10 Limitations and important considerations.
    - For best practice it is recommended subsequent materials/systems are applied as soon as primer is dry, but no latter than 24hrs. This includes second coats of Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier.
    - Should the 24hr time be exceeded the surface must be lightly abraded, vacuumed and wiped with clean water prior to further the applications.
    - Do not allow dust to settle on the surface before next applications.
    - If surface does become contaminated by dust for example, or initial coat passes 24hrs sand the surface and re-apply.
    - Protect from freezing at all times
    - Construction Joints require pre-treatment. Treat as follows:
    - Freshly applied Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier should be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 24 hours.
    - Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier is not to be diluted under any circumstances.
    - When used in conjunction with SikaBond® Wood Floor Adhesives, SikaFloor® 158W Fast Barrier must not be broadcast with sand. SikaFloor® 158W Fast Barrier is recommended for use with all polyurethane and hybrid wood floor SikaBond® adhesives.
    - Static Cracks: prefill and level with SikaDur® or Sikafloor® epoxy resin.
    - Dynamic cracks: to be assessed and if necessary apply a stripe coat of elastomeric material or design as a movement joint.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate temperature. +10°C min. / +40°C max.
5.3 Substrate moisture content.
    - In-situ probe test up to 100% RH
    All testing/readings should conform with relevant AS/NZ standards
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.10):
    - Protect from freezing at all times
5.5 Basis of the stated values.
    - Manufactured in Australia.
    - All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier, October 2025, Version 01.15, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikafloor_-158_wfastbarrier.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier Part A, version 20/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sds-sikafloor-158wfastbarrierparta.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier Part B, version 22/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sds-sikafloor-158wfastbarrierpartb.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaFloor: Resin Flooring Solutions, version 08/11/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/Sikafloor%20Resin%20BROCHURE%202023%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
